.animate_mover
    LDA #&80
    STA hostile_mover               \ Set to negative to indicate no hostile mover
    STA mover_had_hostile_collision \ Set to negative to indicate no hostile collision
    LDY mover_to_update             \ grind: get_mover_type inlined (Y = &03, A = type); its Z (Y = 0 is the player) replaces TYA
    BNE am_common_e3fb              \ grind: not the player (Z from the LDY)
    LDA player_helicopter           \ *** Zero if player not in helicopter
    BEQ am_common_e3fb              \ *** (the helicopter test first: it and the skeleton test only skip, so the order is free)
    LDA helicopter_fuel_high        \ ***
    BMI skip_animation              \ *** Don't animate player helicopter if out of fuel
.am_common_e3fb
    LDA movers_type_and_colour,Y
    AND #&7F
    CMP #&0D                        \ MOVER_TYPE_SKELETON
    BEQ skip_animation
    TAX
    LDA movers_frame_and_flip,Y     \ grind: the next frame kept in A and compared with the type's
    AND #&7F                        \ frame count in place (frames, &C6, no longer written: nothing
    INC A                           \ 65C02 opcode; else reads it)
    CMP mover_types_animation_frame,X
    BCS am_wrap_e3fb                \ grind: the wrap has its own store (A would be 0, so ORA flip is just flip)
    ORA flip
    STA movers_frame_and_flip,Y
.skip_animation
    LDA movers_y,Y
    RTS
.am_wrap_e3fb
    LDA flip
    STA movers_frame_and_flip,Y
    LDA movers_y,Y
    RTS
candidates.summary: animate_mover: LDY's Z replaces TYA/BNE (player test out of the non-player path), and the frame wrap gets its own store so the common no-wrap path falls through with BCS not taken. Alternatives (overlapping): candidate 2 (layout only, zero shift) and 3 (BEQ layout).
candidates.equivalence: animate_mover: on every exit A = movers_y,Y and Y = mover_to_update; X is not live at either caller (the move_mover_* routines load their own X; plot_mover TAXes before reading X), and hostile_mover and mover_had_hostile_collision are set as before. LDY sets Z, so the player (Y=0) test needs no TYA. The player's helicopter/fuel skip is tested before the skeleton skip instead of after: both only go to skip_animation, with no side effects, so the order is free; the player not in a helicopter, or with fuel, falls into the common path exactly as before (type load, skeleton test, TAX, frame step). The wrap: old BCC skip / LDA #0 / ORA flip / STA stored flip when A >= limit; new BCS wrap / LDA flip / STA, then the same LDA movers_y,Y : RTS duplicated. The no-wrap path is the old one (ORA flip, STA).
candidates.relies_on: Non-player path -2 (TYA gone, BNE still taken), player path -2, wrap path -1 (BCS taken 3 + LDA flip 3 vs BCC 2 + LDA #0 2 + ORA 3), no-wrap path -1 (BCS not taken 2 vs BCC taken 3). Measured executions a pass: 1.7 animate_mover entries (1.4 non-player, 0.3 player), 1.7 compares (0.85 wraps): about 3.4 + 1.7 = 5.1 cycles a pass. Bytes: +6 (51 -> 57), so move_mover_right and all after it up to the EQUB &EA pad before is_descending_helicopter shift up 6 in non-gameplay builds; I cannot count the page crossings that moves: move_mover_up_and_right..down_and_left (&20C7-&20E0 in the bench) stay in page &20 so the HI ASSERT holds, but hot branches or indexed reads after may change crossing and the gate decides. Inside the routine nothing crosses (it spans &1FC9-&2001, every branch is within page &1F; the duplicated LDA movers_y,Y straddles &2000 but instruction fetch costs nothing extra). Labels am_common_e3fb, am_wrap_e3fb are unique. Removed labels is_player_23a9, not_player_23b1, skip_wraparound_23c3 are referenced nowhere else (grepped src/, tools/). No entry past a label: animate_mover is only called by JSR animate_mover (lines 2966, 3241). Player in a helicopter with fuel is also 2 cycles faster (no TYA).
